systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Hydrodynamic Jet Cavitation-Assisted Supercritical Antisolvent Micronization (HJC-SAS) Industrial Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Aseptic High-Pressure Supercritical Antisolvent Co-Crystallization Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / USP <467> Residual Solvents / USP <429> Light Diffraction Particle Sizing / 3-A Sanitary Standards 63-04 & 08-17 / EHEDG Type EL Class I CIP / ASME Section VIII Div 1 & ASME B31.3 High-Pressure Process Piping)
systemArchitectures.technology: Continuous high-velocity liquid micro-jet cavitation impingement inside high-pressure dense-phase supercritical CO2 antisolvent (120 – 200 bar, 35 – 42 °C, v_jet > 100 m/s) across opposed ruby/sapphire micro-orifices, achieving instantaneous turbulent micro-mixing (Da < 0.05, tau_mix < 0.8 ms), localized ultrasonic shockwave cavitation collapse (Delta_P > 150 bar), extreme supersaturation ratios (S > 1000), and uniform precipitation of sub-80 nm amorphous polyphenol co-crystals (d_50 < 75 nm, Span < 0.80) with in-line scCO2 dynamic washing reducing residual ethanol below 50 ppm
systemArchitectures.residualSolventPpm: < 50 ppm (Ethanol / Ethyl Lactate, USP <467> Limit 5,000 ppm)
systemArchitectures.cipSanitizationRating: 100% Resistant to 2.0% NaOH at 80°C, 1.5% Peracetic Acid (PAA) at 50°C, Automated Clean-in-Place (CIP) & Supercritical CO2 Sterile Depressurization Conformance

micronizationFormulations.name: Quercetin Dihydrate & Polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP-K30) Amorphous Nanocrystal Dispersion
micronizationFormulations.formulationDescription: Natural antioxidant flavonoid quercetin dihydrate co-precipitated with hydrophilic polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP-K30) matrix to eliminate crystalline lattice barrier and elevate oral bioavailability.
micronizationFormulations.bioactiveSolute: Quercetin Dihydrate (98% purity, 4.0% w/v) in Food-Grade Anhydrous Ethanol
micronizationFormulations.degradingAlternative: High-Pressure Spray Drying (150°C inlet temperature causing 44% thermal oxidation, crystal sintering, and 2,800 ppm residual ethanol)
micronizationFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA GRAS 21 CFR § 182.1 / USP <467> Class 3 Compliant

micronizationFormulations.name: Curcumin & Phosphatidylcholine High-Bioavailability Co-Crystal Nano-Dispersion
micronizationFormulations.formulationDescription: Turmeric curcuminoids co-crystallized with hydrogenated soy phosphatidylcholine forming an amphiphilic delivery complex that bypasses hepatic glucuronidation.
micronizationFormulations.bioactiveSolute: Curcumin Extract (95% curcuminoids, 3.5% w/v) in Absolute Ethanol / Ethyl Acetate (80:20)
micronizationFormulations.degradingAlternative: Rotary Evaporator & Wet Ball Milling (Agglomerated micro-particles d > 1,500 nm, 850 ppm residual solvent, heavy metal wear contaminants)
micronizationFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA GRAS Notice GRN 000822 & EFSA Botanical Monograph

micronizationFormulations.name: Trans-Resveratrol & Hydroxypropyl-β-Cyclodextrin (HP-β-CD) Inclusion Complex
micronizationFormulations.formulationDescription: Polygonum trans-resveratrol molecularly entrapped within hydroxypropyl-β-cyclodextrin truncated cone cavities via cavitation shockwave co-precipitation.
micronizationFormulations.bioactiveSolute: Trans-Resveratrol (99% purity, 2.5% w/v) in Anhydrous Ethanol
micronizationFormulations.degradingAlternative: Freeze Drying / Lyophilization (48-hour cycle time, high sublimation energy consumption, 18% trans-to-cis photo-isomerization)

micronizationFormulations.name: Epigallocatechin Gallate (EGCG) & Sodium Caseinate Micro-Jet Nanocomplex
micronizationFormulations.formulationDescription: Green tea catechin EGCG entrapped in hydrophobic micellar casein sub-domains to prevent auto-oxidation and astringent taste in functional food formulations.
micronizationFormulations.bioactiveSolute: Epigallocatechin Gallate (94% EGCG, 3.0% w/v) in Ethyl Lactate / Water (70:30)
micronizationFormulations.polymerCarrier: Spray-Dried Native Sodium Caseinate (1:2 protein matrix ratio)
micronizationFormulations.degradingAlternative: Hot Air Fluidized Bed Coating (95°C air causing 52% EGCG epimerization into inactive GCG and bitter browning)

micronizationFormulations.name: Co-Enzyme Q10 (Ubiquinone) & Hydrogenated Soy Lecithin Amorphous Nanospheres
micronizationFormulations.formulationDescription: High-melting point ubiquinone (T_m = 49°C) preserved in an amorphous, non-crystalline nano-state to eliminate low gastrointestinal solubility constraints.
micronizationFormulations.bioactiveSolute: Co-Enzyme Q10 (99.5% purity, 5.0% w/v) in Ethanol / Hexane-Free Bio-Solvent
micronizationFormulations.polymerCarrier: Hydrogenated Soy Lecithin & D-Alpha Tocopheryl Succinate (1:1.2 ratio)
micronizationFormulations.degradingAlternative: Cryogenic Jet Milling (Severe static agglomeration d > 3,800 nm, high mechanical attrition losses, no crystalline state reduction)
